editor.title: Booth allocation
editor.subtitle: Place booths on the hall floor and allocate them to accepted circles.
editor.hint: Drag a booth to move it. Tap one to edit or allocate it.
editor.placeHint: Tap anywhere on the floor to place a new booth.
editor.emptyTitle: No booths on this floor yet
editor.emptyBody: Add the first booth, or import a plan you exported earlier.
editor.unplacedBody: {{count}} booth(s) exist but have no position yet. Open one and set its position, or drag it in from the list.

list.title: Booths
list.noResults: No booth matches that search on this floor.

detail.title: Booth {{number}}

clear.title: Clear every placement on floor {{level}}?
clear.body: {{count}} booth(s) lose their position. The booths and their circle allocations stay; only the layout is cleared. Export the plan first if you might want it back.

conflict.duplicateNumber: Booth number {{booth}} is already used at this event.
